title: Secure coding practices
goal_html: Groups perform a mini code review on a printed set of snippets, flagging every secure-coding violation and proposing the one-line fix for each. Ties to LO 5.5.A, 5.5.B.
steps_html:
1. Each group works through the the simulation review queue (or a printed handout of the same snippets), marking each PASS or FLAG.
  2. For every FLAG, the group writes the one-line fix (e.g. "switch to a parameterized query", "load the key from an environment variable", "run as a non-root service account").
  3. Groups then pick their own two-line code/config snippet (from a past project, a textbook example, or invented) and challenge another group to find the violation.
collaborate_html: Assign roles: a "reviewer" flags violations, a "fixer" proposes the one-line remediation, and a "referee" checks the fix actually addresses the root cause (not just silences the symptom). Rotate roles partway through.
exit_html: Each group submits: the snippet they wrote for the challenge round, its violation (if any), and the fix.
